ns2:course.label: Advanced Turkish II
ns2:course.description: Continuation of TURK 405 with increased emphasis on conversational fluency and comprehension of advanced level grammar in the reading of a variety of prose texts on current cultural issues. 3 undergraduate hours. 3 graduate hours. Prerequisite: TURK 405 or equivalent.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: 3 undergraduate hours. 3 graduate hours. Prerequisite: TURK 405 or equivalent.
